I have farmed this land for many years without buying fertilizer or chemicals from the shop, and at my age I do not have the strength or money to start now. My children and grandchildren will help me work this small plot by hand with the hoe, just as we have always done. We will plant the seeds we saved from last season because they grow well here and do not cost us anything, and we will wait for the rains to come as they always have.
